changelog: EVA 3.0 Web Experience: Bounded LRU WebView engine (max 3 instances, 64% RAM reduction), Chromium onRenderProcessGone crash auto-recovery, granular per-service WebProfile security registry with hardware permission gating, native dock forward/backward navigation, real-time offline detection banner, native DownloadManager with authenticated cookie synchronization, and Android AudioManager focus integration with ducking support.
